title: States document block
description: Every interactive state a component can have (hover, focus, disabled, loading, etc.). Each item covers what triggers it, how it looks and behaves, and which tokens change.

stateEntry.description: A state, defined as a visual or behavioral change triggered by user interaction, a system event, or a data condition.

description.description: What triggers this state, how appearance and behavior change, and any constraints or side effects.

tokens.description: Token overrides for this state (only ones that change from the default). The default values live on `design-specifications` for components.

rationale.description: Why this state exists (the user need or design rationale it addresses).

examples.description: Examples showing the component in this state.

states.description: Every interactive state of a component or pattern. List them in a sensible order: usually default, hover, focus, active, then disabled, loading, and other special states.

kind.description: Identifies this block as a states spec.

items.description: The states, in order. Tools SHOULD keep this order for display.
